headline: COMET DRIFT GP gets its grand prix: the COMET CUP — three races, one title
lede: Slot a took the never-dry rung's honest pick (COMET DRIFT GP, the shelf's weakest title) and shipped the #419 "not yet cups": a three-leg points grand prix with a title-arming badge, live points panels, and the whole mode proven in Node and in Chrome.

notes.text: The COMET CUP: Gulch, Sandbank, Corkscomb back to back; 10-8-6-4-3-2-1 across the seven-kart field on the live classification; standings between legs, a champion crowned at the flag (ties: wins, best finish, name). Arm with C or the gold badge on the title.

All cup rules live in a pure module (cup.js) audited end-to-end: cometcheck grew 15 gates including a hand-computed GP standings string and three tiebreak tables, plus three mutants that all die. sim.js untouched — physics, stateHash and every seed-pin keep their meaning.

cometcupplay drives the whole mode in Chrome with real keys/taps: pixel-verifies the armed badge, races all three legs on the game's own certified autopilot (the checkpoint gates reject any shortcut), and checks the panel points equal the real finishing places.
Main sat frozen (nightly #48 red on an archery gate) — but that gate was already fixed by #1741, and a fresh nightly over current main was dispatched to clear the merge.
